channel.title: Shelby County Newspapers - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Shelby County Newspapers (shelbycountyreporter.com)

item.title: Tee King becomes Pelham’s all-time leading scorer in series sweep of Marbury
item.description: Pelham’s Tee King became the program’s all-time leading scorer in a dominant collective offensive effort for the Panthers on the road at Marbury.

item.title: Thompson, Indian Springs advance to bowling state tournament
item.description: Thompson’s girls bowling team won the south regional championship to advance to state alongside the Warriors boys bowling team and Indian Springs girls bowling team.

item.title: ‘Champions in all we do:’ Tad Niblett shares vision for Chelsea as new head football coach
item.description: New Chelsea head football coach Tad Niblett introduced his family to the community on Tuesday as he shared his vision of how he plans to lead the program into a new era.

item.title: Board of Directors decides to close Alabaster YMCA due to cost, facility needs
item.description: The Alabaster YMCA will close at the end of May 2026.

item.title: Shelby County business leaders outline outlook for 2026 at Chamber conference
item.description: Business leaders from across Shelby County shared insight into economic trends, workforce challenges and growth opportunities during the Shelby County Chamber’s 11th annual Business Outlook Conference on Wednesday, Jan. 28, at the Pelham Civic Complex and Ice Arena.

item.title: Shelby County Chamber highlights strong 2025, unveils new leadership and strategic plan
item.description: The Shelby County Chamber reflected on a year of economic growth and outlined its vision for the future during its 45th Annual Investors’ Meeting on Wednesday, Jan. 28, at the Pelham Civic Complex and Ice Arena.

item.title: Alabama Semiquincentennial Commission to offer community grants beginning Jan. 30
item.description: The Alabama USA Semiquincentennial Commission announced plans to distribute up to $725,000 in grant funding to support local commemorations of the 250th anniversary of the signing of the Declaration of Independence.

item.title: Max Motorsports fuels Pelham’s powersports passion with family-owned approach
item.description: For more than two decades, Max Motorsports has been helping riders across Central Alabama stay on the road—and in the dirt—by combining technical expertise with a passion for the sport that runs deep within its walls.

item.title: Veteran Pelham baseball squad looks to take next step in second year under Guy Howard
item.description: Pelham baseball enters the 2026 season with momentum, experience and a clear vision of what success looks like.

item.title: Oak Mountain, Briarwood enter boys basketball rankings as Pelham rises, Chelsea girls hold
item.description: Oak Mountain and Briarwood joined the ASWA’s boys basketball rankings alongside Pelham at No. 4 for Class 6A boys and Chelsea at No. 9 for Class 6A girls.
